A non-owner SR-22 policy provides liability coverage for you as a driver, regardless of which vehicle you're operating — as long as you don't own it. That means you're covered driving a friend's car, a rental, or a borrowed vehicle, without needing to insure a specific car you don't have. It satisfies Florida's filing requirement the same way a standard owner policy does, just structured around the driver rather than the vehicle.

Per Florida FLHSMV's official insurance requirements, Florida law requires you to maintain financial responsibility for the full required period regardless of your vehicle ownership status. A non-owner policy exists specifically to make that possible without forcing you to buy or insure a car you don't need.

sections.heading: Who Typically Needs This Coverage

  • You need your license reinstated for work but don't currently own a car
  • You rely on rideshares, borrowed vehicles, or public transit day-to-day
  • You're between vehicles and don't want a lapse in your filing
  • You're looking for the lowest-cost way to satisfy the SR-22 requirement
